# Archived one-shot workflows

GitHub Actions only runs YAML under `.github/workflows/`. These 391 files are closed campaign jobs (shadow lanes, remaining11, p9 one-shots, top-tier waves). They stay in git as evidence.

Live workflows that still run:

- `ci.yml`
- `orion-v1-freeze.yml`
- `reusable-sealed-self-improvement-v1.yml`
- `self-orion-reusable-sealed-promotion-v1.yml`
- `c7-davenport-frontier.yml`
- `orion-01-05-convergence-v1.yml`
- `rse-formal-verification.yml`
